column3: With respect to the Fulop Brooklyn Multifamily Portfolio 2 Mortgage Loan (0.9%), (i) Ruby Hall Event Space LLC, the sole ground floor commercial tenant at the 104 Graham Avenue Mortgaged Property, has a lease that expires on July 30, 2030 and (ii) The Hot Spot 2, the sole ground floor commercial tenant at 155 Central Avenue Mortgaged Property, has a lease that expires on November 30, 2027.
